name: Lyo.Nfc
description: Read and write NTAG21x user pages and NFC Forum NDEF (Text, URI, or a raw record). `INfcTag` is the page port: `MemoryNfcTag` for tests and dumps, `Lyo.Nfc.Pcsc` for a PC/SC reader. ISO 15693 tags, including Tonie figures, live in `Lyo.Rfid`.
features: **Pages.** `ReadPagesAsync` and `WritePageAsync` move 4-byte Type 2 pages. A page that is not 4 bytes throws.
**NDEF.** `NdefTextRecord`, `NdefUriRecord`, and `NdefRecord.Raw`. `NdefType2` wraps the message in a `0x03` TLV and a `0xFE` terminator.
**NTAG size.** `NtagMemory` knows NTAG213, NTAG215, and NTAG216. User memory starts at page 4. Config and lock pages are not written.

examples.title: Write and read a Text record on an in-memory NTAG213
